g.text: Cue identity differs at step 0; all later observations and imposed forward actions match.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5c6878

g.text: Thin lines: all three training fits, averaged over 16 matched cue pairs each. Thick lines: arithmetic fit means.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5c6878

g.text: Shaded region: initial visible cue. Steps 1+: identical observations. Current-only control must be exactly zero after step 0.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5c6878

g.text: Symmetric-log axes are linear below 1e-8; zero and small fits are retained. Normalized RMS divides state difference by pooled state RMS.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #364354

g.text: Forced actions bypass the learned policy. State differences do not establish usable or decodable memory, gameplay success, or novelty.
